system.description: Win a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty six Traits, or nine if you have only encountered the target through Anima Walk) to project your senses to any place you have visited or person you have met, remaining aware of your own body and surroundings. You may bring other Auspex powers to bear on the scried location. Only other Cainites with Farsight may notice the intrusion, via a Static Mental Challenge against your Willpower. Using a scrying implement grants two bonus Traits on Mental Challenges while scrying.
